description: The scope was revised and the task now asks for a capability the plan never agreed to build. Nothing is broken and nothing is worth retrying: the demand is outside the agreed scope, so the attempt is skipped, it does not count against the same-cause counter, and the question is put to a human. Raised at the execution stage, because the agent meets the demand before it does the work, so the question hangs off the task rather than off a check.

verdict.actual_result: task T-004 asks for a tenant-routing decision layer; the scope agreed for this plan covers the read-only report endpoint only, so no tenant-routing behaviour was ever agreed to be built
verdict.evidence_quote: the scope agreed for this plan covers the read-only report endpoint only
